all: China donates 955,845 million dobras to Sao Tome and Principe for unspecified projects in 2018
China donates 502.850 million dobras to Sao Tome and Principe for unspecified projects in 2019
Chinese Government cancels $18.4 million of the Government of the STP’s outstanding debt obligations (linked to #71266, #55639, #68381, and #55648)
Chinese Government provides STP with $10.9 million of general budget support (linked to #55639)
Chinese Government provides USD 10 million of general budget support in 2018 (Linked to umbrella project #55639)
Chinese Government provides $5 million of general budget support to STP (Linked to Project ID#55639)
Chinese Government donates 100,000 Sinovac Covid-19 vaccine doses worth $1.8 million in September 2021
Chinese Government donates 1,000 tons of rice worth $1 million
CIDCA granted 1,000,000 USD in agreement with UNFPA to provide healthcare assistance to Sao Tome and Principe
Chinese Government donates 130,000 euros worth of medical supplies and equipment in 2019
